title: Lantau in the morning, the Peak at sunset
summary: Out to Lantau for the first cable car, lunch in Central, then the Peak for sunset and Temple Street at night. Check the wind at breakfast: if the cable car is not running, switch to the backup below.

rows.what: Lounge breakfast, go or no-go check
rows.detail: Hong Kong Observatory warnings and wind, and the Ngong Ping 360 service status on np360.com.hk. Suspended or a reduced service: switch to the backup below.
About 50 minutes, one change at Lai King (How-to 20).
Klook voucher, valid any day to 31 October (How-to 20). First car, shortest queues. 25 minutes.

rows.what: Big Buddha, Po Lin Monastery, Wisdom Path
rows.detail: 268 steps up. Skip most of the village.

rows.what: Tung Chung line to Hong Kong Station
rows.detail: About 30 minutes, direct. Hong Kong Station joins Central underground.

Yat Lok, 34-38 Stanley Street: Michelin starred roast goose, order a quarter over lai fun noodles, plus char siu. Daily 10:00 to 20:30, walk-in, short queue, about ten minutes from Hong Kong Station. Yum cha is Friday's lunch.
Standard one-way ticket, prebooked. Garden Road lower terminus, about 15 minutes' walk from lunch. Sit on the right going up, then Lugard Road for the best free view (How-to 19).
Stay while the city lights come on.
From the rank by the Peak Galleria. Show 佐敦 廟街 (Temple Street, Jordan), or 尖沙咀 喜來登酒店 for the hotel. Tram seats face backwards going down.

rows.what: Temple Street dinner and night market
rows.detail: Hing Kee, 15 Temple Street: claypot rice, order it first as it takes 20 minutes, plus the oyster omelette. Evenings from 17:30, cash only, walk-in. Then browse the stalls. A 15 minute walk from the hotel, or MTR one stop to Jordan.

notes: If the Peak is in cloud

Low cloud hides the view, so check the Peak webcam or look up from Central at 15:00. If it is socked in, skip the tram: go up the ICC to Sky100 (100F) or Ozone (118F) for sunset instead, then Temple Street as planned.

Tai Cheong Bakery has a branch in the Peak Galleria for an egg tart while you wait for sunset. Sky Terrace 428, the paid roof deck on the Peak Tower, is the easy option if Lugard Road is too dark or wet.
Lantau in the rain is grim and the cable car may close. Swap to the backup (the box below) and spend the morning at the pool or in the lounge.
